content:
One of the most common hidden costs when switching to a new phone is having to replace your case if the dimensions change.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, this would seem like an unavoidable expense, but two accessory manufacturers don't think so — and one is even betting big on this claim...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, noting that it is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right of the packaging reads in English and French:

Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself isn't entirely convinced, commenting that "it seems a bit early to be saying this now." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad — whose company makes anti-glare screen protectors for the iPhone — says his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, leakers claimed that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but later materials leaked from an iPhone supplier also indicated that the iPhone 18 Pro would be two millimeters thicker than its predecessor.

If so, this would continue the current trend, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than the previous generation.

However, not all leakers agree — some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will have the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide case manufacturers with dimensional information ahead of time to ensure third-party cases are available when the new iPhone launches. But on the other hand, accessory manufacturers sometimes place orders based solely on rumors and sometimes get it wrong. Personally, I won't pre-order a case until I actually see the new iPhone released.
